scope: Solo CB_COMPOUND/CB_SEQUENCE probes with a single per-session slot, exact replay after uncertain completion, cross-transport recovery, dynamic slot limits, and CB_PATH_DOWN_SESSION. Delegation, other callback operations and RPCSEC_GSS callbacks remain unfinished.

checks: CREATE_SESSION binds a bidirectional transport; CB_NULL uses the requested program/version and AUTH_NONE while forechannel RPC stays usable
probe replies are bound to their exact TCP connection and XID; cross-connection, duplicate and unknown replies cannot change path state
BACKCHANNEL_CTL changes program and invalidates old probes; malformed matched replies keep path down and idempotent rebinding reprobes it
cleared callback credentials and destroyed/recreated sessions cannot be validated by a stale probe response
BIND_CONN_TO_SESSION supports BACK and BACK_OR_BOTH on new transports, rejects invalid directions and changes to existing channel roles
AUTH_SYS CB_NULL carries the offered timestamp, machine name, UID/GID and supplementary groups exactly
five-second probe timeout ignores late success; rebind recovers the path without recreating the session
losing the only callback transport sets CB_PATH_DOWN on a surviving forechannel connection
CB_NULL success alone does not validate the sequenced backchannel; CB_SEQUENCE success on the wrong transport is ignored
truncated/trailing XDR, bad status/tag/count/op/session/sequence/slot and valid CB_SEQUENCE errors preserve the exact pending request; only a valid reply advances it
successful CB_SEQUENCE advances exactly once; BACKCHANNEL_CTL retains the session sequence and ignores old duplicate replies
callback program replacement cancels the old RPC XID while replaying the unresolved CB_COMPOUND with the same session slot and sequence
CB_COMPOUND timeout ignores late success and rebinding replays the exact unresolved sequence
one callback slot serializes multiple bound paths; transport loss retries the unresolved request on another bound connection
loss of the only backchannel with an unanswered CB_COMPOUND reports CB_PATH_DOWN_SESSION; binding a replacement clears that flag and preserves the pending sequence
client-advertised slot growth beyond CREATE_SESSION and shrink back to zero are accepted without allocation or increasing callback concurrency
destroying and recreating a session starts a distinct callback slot at sequence one; old CB_COMPOUND success cannot validate it
UINT32_MAX offered callback slots require only slot zero; AUTH_SYS credentials must fit the negotiated complete CB_COMPOUND request size
TCP record fragmentation and MOUNT v3 with independent XDR codecs
unknown UID/GID/groups rejected; root squashed to explicitly unprivileged subject
root squash uses anonymous read rights, strips privileged groups and rejects writes/revoked rights
read-only TCP portmapper advertises NFS and does not advertise unsupported NLM version 3
trailing XDR rejected before WRITE; previously persisted bytes remain intact
v3 guarded CREATE, 64 KiB UNSTABLE upgraded to FILE_SYNC, READ, COMMIT, exact duplicate WRITE
MAC tamper rejected; file handle survives external rename and all-service restart; durable v3 replay and new write verifier
deleted/recreated path cannot revive an old file handle
v3 MKDIR, cross-directory RENAME, READDIRPLUS, REMOVE/RMDIR type separation
pynfs v4.1 EXCHANGE_ID/CREATE_SESSION/SEQUENCE, guarded OPEN, WRITE/READ, exact slot replay
false slot replay and foreign stateid rejected; GETATTR subset independently decoded
old sessions/stateids invalidated on reboot; persisted owner can reclaim OPEN during grace; CLOSE releases recovery record
unrelated client cannot reclaim another owner after restart
export disable revokes existing handles through fresh identity grants
offline metadata backup strips NFS enrollment and excludes persistent capability/recovery databases
BIND_CONN_TO_SESSION on a fresh connection, PUTPUBFH, TEST_STATEID old/current states, FREE_STATEID held/unlocked states and read-only OPEN_DOWNGRADE
one kernel-style session accepts multiple mapped users without sharing their open authority
exclusive lock conflicts, denied owner details, disjoint writes and CLOSE with held locks
partial unlock splits ranges and preserves neighboring conflicts
process restart persists split lock ranges; matching client reclaims OPEN and locks before RECLAIM_COMPLETE

limits: Only solo CB_SEQUENCE requests are produced; CB_RECALL/CB_NOTIFY_LOCK and other callback operations are not yet implemented.
AUTH_NONE/AUTH_SYS callbacks only; RPCSEC_GSS callbacks remain unfinished.
The original pynfs CSESS20/CSESS21 selection checks callback program/version, not full delegation or sequencing conformance.
No claim of complete SMB/NFS conformance.
